audience: HR and office managers who check attendance, overtime and time entries in Tempika

useCases.title: List employees without personal data
useCases.text: List the employees of the tenant with their id, status, company and external reference. Page through the list with the next cursor.

useCases.title: Review the workday report for a period
useCases.text: Get the totals for a period: entries, distinct employees, overtime, absence requests and net hours bank. The report has no personal data.

useCases.title: Review clock-in and clock-out entries
useCases.text: List the clock-in and clock-out entries for a period. Filter by company or employee. Use a shorter date range when the result is cut off.

useCases.title: Check which tools an API key can use
useCases.text: Check the tenant, scopes and per-minute request limit of the Tempika API key before you run reports.
